question: Tierra de Oliva avocado oil company owner parent brand
markdown:
There is no legitimate company or corporate parent brand named
Tierra de Oliva
producing avocado oil. Food safety authorities (such as
ANMAT
in Argentina) classified "Tierra de Oliva" extra virgin olive oil as an apocryphal, unregistered, and illegal product carrying fake registry numbers tied to a non-existent or fraudulent label ("Establecimiento Los Juárez" in La Rioja).
La Nación
Regulatory Status
Product Type:
Falsely labeled olive oil (not a verified avocado oil brand).
Declared (Fake) Packer:
Establecimiento Los Juárez (Chamical, La Rioja, Argentina).
Action Taken:
Banned across
⁠National Administration of Medicines, Food and Medical Technology
due to non-existent RNE and RNPA food safety registry numbers.
Argentina.gob.ar
